name: kbc-loop
description: KBC Loop: web, app (iOS + Android) en api op één database

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,insights,app -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @kbc-loop/api" "npm run dev -w @kbc-loop/web" "npm run dev -w @kbc-loop/insights" "npm run start -w @kbc-loop/app"
scripts.test: npm test -w @kbc-loop/shared && npm test -w @kbc-loop/api && npm run check:readme
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @kbc-loop/web && npm run lint -w @kbc-loop/insights
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kbc-loop/web && npm run build -w @kbc-loop/insights && npm run export:web -w @kbc-loop/app
